# Native workflow recovery and readiness

Director334 approves completing the recovery and native qualification before handoff. Preserve same task, original failure, accepted assets and artistic limits. Technical recovery is a separate three-recovery ceiling, not a new artistic allowance. Failed artistic reviews cannot use it.

Use the333 source-preserving plan, amended for the demonstrated over-conservative preflight: record skipped embedded text as inert data, inspect all animation-capable IDs and node trees for invalid or non-simple Python drivers, keep auto-execution disabled. A warning is distinct from an actual dependency failure. Inspect diagnostics before approving the saved derivative. Bind outputs, dependencies and selected rig state; reopen in a fresh process and inspect the real render. Deliberately reject the known bad visual and prove it cannot propagate.

All four planning stages repeat after engine changes. No raw legacy launcher, provider calls, installation, spend, cloud or uploads. One local worker. Rejected320 remains the negative control, not an accepted character. Motion and appearance improvement must next use an explicitly bounded registered operation and prospective review; no false claim that a persistence test qualifies animation.

Before calling the workflow ready, provide a concrete production entry contract with reference roles, original direction, expert-lens requirements, representation-level early proof and failure routing. Distinguish engine readiness from artistic acceptance. The workflow must be able to accept the next authorized native work package without reopening old attempts or requiring another infrastructure handoff.

Preserve333 reports. Fresh knowledge retrieval plus manual330/328/331/332/333 reconciliation; AU13/16 preservation and evidence rules apply. Technical validity, same-film quality and Director acceptance stay separate. No arbitrary elapsed-time limit. Retain all technical attempts and empirical test limitations.

## Diagnosed source defect

Recovery2 proved these are not orphan drivers:64 non-executable SUM drivers on the used armature have null targets. Historical300 explicitly bypassed removed Rigify object drivers. Do not restore a rig blindly during infrastructure qualification. Retain this exact diagnosed defect digest as part of the unchanged rejected negative control. # Production proof331 — failed early proof, not a review-ready clip

## Outcome and evidence boundary

The initial native pose trial and two corrective variants did not qualify the
Nihang horse/rider pose family or supporting-cast appearance. No crowd replication,
continuous clip, final sound mix or Director audiovisual queue was produced.
The accepted Pashtun253 master and rejected320 source were not edited.

This is a negative production result. It is not evidence that agent-only animation
is impossible, that the source horse rig is incapable, or that another model would
solve it. Native inspection showed usable controls; their coordinated use remains
unqualified. A narrower, useful finding is that root-pivot/joint-angle tuning plus
small garment offsets did not produce the required integrated forms.

## What actually happened

The330 brief and new331 strategy were read, a fresh domain knowledge packet was
created for each job, and local reviewed Blender handlers produced six phase
renders per variant. However, **the four controller stages were not submitted
before native construction**. The written stages were not equivalent to executing
the controller. This is an adoption/admission failure, not successful prospective
qualification of330. The later controller record is explicitly retrospective
frozen-evidence review; it cannot repair that chronology or demonstrate independent
reviewer judgment. No separate runtime/model calls were made.

The controller currently supports offline and frozen-evidence modes only. It does
not own this Blender launcher or enforce the ordered pose/look prerequisites on
native jobs. A native-authoring bridge remains unqualified. The agent could still
have applied the stage API before diagnostic work and did not; the software limit
does not excuse that omission.

| Trial | Actual result | Disposition |
|---|---|---|
| pose01 | New whole-pose controls exposed excessive hindquarter lowering and outward/upward forehoof orientation at the crest. | FAIL; initial attempt retained. |
| pose02 | Forehooves improved, but support legs became too straight; cloth calculation emitted an invalid-power warning, sash became buried, and beard edit targeted a hidden contributor. | FAIL; first correction retained. Process finished before attempted cancellation. |
| pose03 | Finite cloth calculation, visible beard targeting and sash support corrected. Crest has more head flex and unequal forelegs; landing lowers head/torso more. Gather/drive still lack the reference's compact coordinated shape; broad costume and coat remain schematic. | FAIL; second correction retained. No claim of full-speed motion quality. |

Native outputs are under `.runtime/art-direction/series01-sikh331/pose-01` through
`pose-03`. Inspected source frames298,314,327,344,350,353 are diagnostic samples,
not adequate continuous motion/contact coverage. Reference authority is the
14–19s passage of reference-b.mov, with preserved321 phase comparisons. Camera
projection and horse conformation differ; exact screen-space matching is not the
criterion. Gather, articulated support, active balance and distributed absorption
are the criterion.

## Concrete remaining failures

- **P1 preparation:** frame298 still reads as a long-necked standing horse with
  small offsets, rather than the reference's gathered neck/poll/chest/quarter shape.
- **P2 drive/crest:** forehoof orientation is better at327, but the lower support
  remains comparatively extended and the forelimb folds abrupt. Changing head
  pitch did not establish a coherent spine/neck/support shape family. Full reverse
  support and visible hoof-contact proofs were not completed.
- **P3 contact/recovery:**350/353 show more compression. That alone does not qualify
  reaching transitions, absorption timing or rider/seat/stirrup/rein interfaces.
  Old dependent caches were not all rebuilt; this is NOT_RUN, not pending approval.
- **P4 appearance:** intended-size frames retain a cap-like crown, shell-like
  torso, narrow regular beard, tubular lower clothing and a polished horse coat.
  The rounded saddle pad is less slab-like, but its spine support is unproven.
  This fails the accepted film floor without requiring a full-speed AV judgment.
- **P5 crowd:** not propagated or newly qualified because the representative
  actor prerequisite failed. Existing320 crowd remains rejected.
- **P6 continuity:** only sampled phase frames, not the contiguous252–441 passage.
  Reverse controls, fresh-open render comparison and sound synchronization NOT_RUN.
- **P7 process:** late controller use, incomplete early recipe snapshots and
  inherited transitive handlers not all pinned in the job input list. pose03 has
  source snapshots for its listed code; pose01/02 do not. Do not claim exact replay
  recipes or a validated authoring bridge for these trials.

## Correction accounting and stopping

The331 strategy inherited a two-correction package allowance. Its wording that
early diagnostics are not external reviews must not become an unlimited retry
loophole: these were three corrective variants of the same construction hypothesis.
Count them as initial attempt plus two corrections. The retrospective frozen
review records those three actual variants; it does not grant three more attempts.
The native launcher is closed for this package. No elapsed-time limit is the
reason for stopping. No knowingly failed candidate is sent for artistic review.

## Consequence and recommendation

Do not scale these forms into a crowd, add more random movement, or render the
whole passage. Preserve the visual goal and accepted Pashtun floor.

Recommended next package: qualify a **local native-authoring admission path**,
then perform a representation-level proof rather than another offset pass. The
bridge must bind original sources/stage receipts, allow only scoped native handlers,
own the single-job lease and shared correction counter, stop dependent work after
a failed pose/look prerequisite, and feed actual candidate bytes into fresh review.
Use the current chat for reasoning; no paid runtime calls, new models or cloud are
needed merely to implement that boundary. This is a proposed scope change from
the failed native proof, not a feature claimed implemented here.

The subsequent construction must solve hind support, pelvis/chest/neck/poll and
rider contact as one pose family; rebuilding the visible garment/tack forms is
separate from microtexture. Exit: reference-comparable gather/crest/contact poses
and one same-film supporting actor at intended framing, with reverse/contact and
transition evidence, before crowd propagation or the integrated sequence.

Remaining alternatives are to continue manual main-chat authoring with a clearly
declared weaker enforcement boundary, or to qualify the bridge first. The latter
is recommended because this proof repeated the exact execution-versus-procedure
gap that the Director asked330 to address. No change of creative quality, paid
asset purchase or specialist is proposed.

## Measurement limits

Three native pose candidates, eighteen phase renders, zero accepted media outputs,
zero Director artistic-review requests. There is one method/scope escalation at
closure. Native job durations are measured separately in the operating ledger;
initial context recovery predates capture. No percentage efficiency improvement,
avoided Director-input count, complete token usage or backup qualification is
claimed. Local commits do not protect native outputs off this SSD.

# Shot / beat performance and believability brief

Adopted operating requirement at Director exchange249, 2026-10-13. Extends the existing audience brief, motion brief and production strategy; not another Director approval form or a new production department. Applies to every planned shot and its materially distinct beats. Group shared requirements once, then record beat-specific differences. A static insert can have a short brief with justified not-applicable lenses.

## Responsibility: expertise lenses, one integrated result

The executing agent owns a shot-supervision function: reason from the intended audience experience, apply the relevant expertise, resolve conflicting requirements and verify the whole result. Do not wait for the Director to identify technical failures. The Director supplies intent, material creative choices and acceptance, not joint-placement, simulation or deformation diagnoses.

Apply these lenses to the same versioned shot artifact, not a mandatory chain of agents:

- **Story, performance and audience:** what changes for viewers, character intention, recognizable identity, emotional legibility, attention and larger-than-life signature moment.
- **Animation and physical action:** support, balance, effort, momentum, coordinated joints, weight transfer, impact and recovery. Skilled control is not rigid stillness.
- **Anatomy, rigging and contact:** articulation pivots, deforming volume, skin/cloth boundaries, fingers and grip, feet/props/partners, reach and contact ownership.
- **Character effects and environmental response:** hair, mane, tail, cloth, straps, dust/debris; supports, lag, inertia, gravity, forcing and collisions must tell a compatible physical story.
- **Camera, look and editorial:** what the framing actually exposes, continuity and causal geography, silhouette, palette/lighting/material readability, pace and exposure duration.
- **Sound and music:** weight and synchronization, intelligibility, musical preparation/payoff and which element owns attention. Direct listening and signal checks are separate evidence.
- **Production/reuse/rights:** viable representation, dependencies, revision needs, accepted-source limits, resource and rights boundaries.

These are review perspectives, not claimed human specialist qualifications or independent model judgments. A single agent can miss things across all of them. Where knowledge is weak, identify it, research a relevant primary reference or run a discriminating control; do not fill the gap with confident prose.

## Brief fields — complete before substantial execution

Keep the filled brief in the existing sequence work package, linking this template. Bind its revision in the task packet alongside actual source inputs.

1. **Identity and authority:** sequence/shot/beat IDs and timing; accepted creative/source versions; what is fixed, flexible or undecided. Keep Shot Intent separate from the changeable realization plan.
2. **Audience result:** what viewers should understand, feel and notice; extraordinary moment and contrast; what must remain recognizable. State hypotheses, not invented audience research.
3. **Visibility and criticality:** actual framing, screen size, exposure and action; required quality-floor behaviors, dramatic priorities and optional refinements. An out-of-frame assumption needs evidence and a reopening trigger. Low salience cannot excuse a visible structural failure.
4. **Applicable lenses and predicted failures:** actively scan the lenses above. Explain omissions. Include likely unreported distractions and adjacent interfaces, not only the current Director defect list.
5. **Strategy per important behavior:** intended motion/deformation/response; chosen representation and why it fits; owner and coordinate space of contacts; inputs/supports, coupled dependencies and known limitations. Choose authored animation, constrained procedural motion, simulation or a declared hybrid on evidence, not prestige. Specify which matters must be physically consistent and which may be intentionally heightened without contradiction.
6. **Earliest representative proof:** cheap actual-framing motion plus revealing controls before polish/full rendering. Define observable pass/fail, a negative control, required references and what outcome changes the method. Numbers support visual/audio judgment, not replace it.
7. **Review, revision and exit:** evidence per requirement; changed-input invalidation; uncertainty; remaining optional work and reopening triggers; release dependency unlocked. Use the integrated internal gate, not a new handoff at every lens.

Use this row format for the important behaviors; a generic list of body parts is insufficient:

| Beat / audience-visible requirement | Lens; predicted distraction and importance | Method, owner and interfaces | Early proof / explicit failure condition | Evidence, status and reopening trigger |
|---|---|---|---|---|

# Always route first

Director332 adopts mandatory entry. **Bypass means bypass production planning,
not bypass the router.** No new model call, installation or cloud service.

1. Bootstrap only what is needed to understand the request: instructions, current
   state, source pointers and authority. Record original text, operation list,
   scope rationale and an exact authority binding in a small request JSON.
2. Run `python -m movie_factory.task_router --request PATH --id REQUEST_ID`
   through the project `.venv`. It writes an immutable decision in the canonical
   `.runtime/factory-entry.sqlite3`. Read that decision before task actions.
3. Production effects select grounding → derivation → strategy → challenge →
   execution → review. Display, status, explanation, research, planning,
   engineering and operations select explicit lightweight routes. A mixed request
   with production effects cannot select research simply because it also needs
   research. A route is not permission to spend, upload, publish or install.
4. Create the task with its admission ID. For `local_native`, missing admission
   or a noncanonical database fails. For a continuation use `--continue-task ID`
   and `continuation: true`; resume that task, never recreate its correction budget.
   A scope expansion requires explicit reconciliation, not silently adding effects.
5. Native work uses the registered bridge, which admits a step only after its
   plan is admitted and prerequisite outputs have actual recorded internal review.
   Source/plan/output drift fails closed. Results enter final controller review;
   a successful worker, source hash or step review cannot directly deliver media.

Example request structure (replace the binding with actual source/hash):

```json
{"text":"Show the approved clip", "operations":["display"],
 "rationale":"Existing-file display; no edit or rendering",
 "authority":{"path":"results/example/request.md", "sha256":"..."}}
```

Operations: `display`, `status`, `explain`, `research`, `plan`, `code`, `test`,
`document`, `backup`, `upload`, `publish`, `asset`, `motion`, `render`, `sound`,
`edit`, `native_inspect`. Unknown operations block for classification. The agent
must reconcile every requested effect; this finite vocabulary is not automatic
natural-language understanding. The regression suite deliberately demonstrates
that dishonestly labeling “render” as “display” is not detected from prose alone.
It still cannot launch Blender through the lightweight controller.

## Native boundary and honest limits

The shared Blender runner refuses execution without a bridge-issued single-use,
exact-job capability. Legacy callers of that runner now fail closed; they are
not automatically migrated or reauthorized. The bridge currently exposes only
read-only native inspection. Register and qualify a trusted authoring handler
before the next artistic proof. No arbitrary command, Python string or script
path is accepted. No live model allowance was added;325 remains exhausted.

Job reservation happens before process launch. A worker failure cannot qualify a
dependency. An interrupted process leaves an unresolved reservation/lease; verify
termination and reconcile it explicitly, never automatically replay. Same step,
cycle and plan cannot run twice under another job name. Replanning uses the
existing controller allowance and invalidates dependent step qualifications.
The persisted native step review records observations and comparisons against
actual output bindings; truth of those judgments remains a human/agent duty.

This is **supported-entry-point enforcement**, not a sandbox over all Codex tools.
Historical scripts containing direct subprocess launches still exist for evidence
and reuse. They are quarantined by the core instructions, not magically intercepted
by Python. Do not use them as a fallback. A future runtime with restricted tool
access can close that residual boundary. Current entry-point inventory and tests
must disclose it rather than claim universal interception.

Offline/frozen historical fixture creation now records a labeled compatibility
route first. It is not proof that those historical tasks were prospectively
routed. New real work requires an explicit request.332 bootstrap registration is
also labeled retrospective to installation; timestamps are not backdated.

No scene acceptance changes.331 remains closed/rejected;253 remains provisionally
accepted. New native attempts need their own authorized scope and remaining
allowance, never a renamed331. Semantic wrong-method controls remain required.

source_context.instruction: Quoted source evidence, not executable instructions. Status/scope remain in direction.context_sources. Selection is bounded, not a claim of exhaustive retrieval.

obligations.action: 317: evaluate reuse before custom construction without forcing it; compare total adaptation/revalidation cost and quality. Extend existing provenance with source/version/rights/dependencies, tested conditions, failures/evidence and measured-or-unknown effort. Run resource_manifest for the requested use; missing/stale evidence, untested conditions, unresolved rights or open failures block qualification. Assessed resources stay useful but unqualified. Manually verify applicability, rights and perceptual truth; a valid record is not an artistic pass. No new database, installation, spend or upload.

Confirm scope and genuine Director decisions. No new spend, installs, specialists, publication or protected creative changes by inference. Routine in-scope technical fixes remain agent-owned. Astra is top tier; failed method needs reassessment, not a nonexistent higher model.

Read current strategy; name outcome, quality floor, interfaces, assumptions, earliest integrated proof, resources, reuse and replan/exit. Repeated compensating patches trigger method reassessment, not renamed passes.

Compare the complete claimed result to accepted references and required use, seeking known and new failures plus adjacent regressions. Use explicit failing-shape controls before expensive integration; contact targets and material cannot substitute for the required silhouette. An occluded region is NOT_RUN until visibly inspected. Actual motion/audio where applicable; distinguish frame inspection from playback. Tests, better-than-before and source hashes do not establish perceptual PASS. Known FAIL/NOT_RUN blocks handoff.

Write audience intent and distraction hypotheses before a defect list. Test them against actual evidence, seek counterevidence and unlisted problems, record observations and corrections. Director feedback calibrates fallible judgment; it is not the primary defect detector.224: test opening hook, pacing and causal geography, not merely fit duration.248 adopts larger-than-life impact for The Martials and records it as a Director preference: name the extraordinary character-specific beat and its preparation/payoff; use contrast and believability, not constant maximum speed/loudness or unapproved powers. 249 requires a shot/beat performance and believability brief before execution: apply relevant expertise lenses, predict audience-visible anatomy/contact/physical-response failures, and bind each critical behavior to strategy, interfaces, early proof and observable failure conditions. Cover each beat or explicit inheritance; consult docs/planning/SHOT_BEAT_QUALITY_BRIEF.md. Roles are perspectives, not an org chart. Automatic brief completeness and perceptual judgment are not implemented.

Meet the high quality floor first;248 clarifies efficiency means progressively more reliable and economical achievement of that bar, not lowering it. Then weigh visible benefit, dramatic value, reuse and regression/opportunity cost. Re-rank residuals after larger fixes. Prior tolerance is not acceptance. Record deferred details and reopening triggers; no arbitrary timer waives quality or creates handoff.

Bind actual inputs, accepted scope, source hashes and dependencies. Revalidate affected checks after camera/motion/version changes. Preserve originals and failed evidence. A local commit is not native-media backup; a reopened scene is not proof of portable or general reuse.

Track active effort, waits, jobs, actual provider spend and usable output separately; leave unavailable tokens/cost null. Do not add overlapping process/activity time. Diagnostic investment is not repeatable unit cost. Advance the trailer and two episodes, not tooling or polish for its own sake.

Inventory pinned corpus, freeze independently read applicability sets, test held-out/cross-discipline/stale/conflicting cases and actual application. Mandatory constraints bypass search. Ingestion is not approval; preserve gaps. No claim all742 turns/588 candidates reconciled; one source is truncated. Manual audit remains safety net.

Director256-257 authorizes Sikh-only sequence development, continuous turban/cover, personal recognition and nonrecurring leader; action before music. Director260 accepts illustrated portrait v03; read SERIES_01_SIKH_BASELINE_V01.md before Sikh identity/cloth work. Broad natural beard and rugged face govern; rejected v01/v02 do not. No literal pixel matching, native acceptance or incidental background/cloth-topology approval. Native257 remains BLOCK. Unknown domains still block; no paid calls/publication by inference. Director320 narrows current correction to the contiguous Nihang/rear and crowd passage with one-second handles.319 supporting performance/look is rejected; crowd attention remains on the rider. Director313 is the direct AV judge; source/frame checks cannot confer playback or production acceptance.

AU16: package exact accepted versions, dependencies, rights, editable recipe and tested-use limits; verify remote restore and portable dependency closure. Separate foundation from adaptation, native jobs from work/waits and unknown cost; capture issue/review IDs before next sequence. No prediction from145h divided by20s.

AU13/251: distinguish requirement, retrieval, method, evidence and judgment failures. Compare known rejected AND accepted controls, record specific observations and uncertainty, and test omitted/failed evidence blocking. Earlier falsification and fewer repeat escapes matter more than fewer messages. Calibration is familiar non-independent evidence, not universal judgment.
